Plot a Voronoi map

Source: R/plot.R
plot.voronoi_map.Rd

Plot a Voronoi map

Usage

# S3 method for class 'voronoi_map'
plot(
  x,
  fill = NULL,
  border = "white",
  lwd = 2,
  show_labels = TRUE,
  label_col = "white",
  label_cex = 0.8,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A voronoi_map object.

fill

Character vector of fill colours, one per cell. Defaults to a perceptually uniform palette.

border

Border colour. Default "white".

lwd

Border width. Default 2.

show_labels

Logical; overlay cell labels? Default TRUE.

label_col

Colour for labels. Default "white".

label_cex

Label size multiplier. Default 0.8.

...

Further arguments passed to plot.default().
